gate.scope: runtime.service (branch stt/maep-v1-20261022): add the fs.write tool adapter, the read-back acceptance provider and MAEP-018 reconciliation; hg serve (main) unchanged; production registration excluded
gate.capability: HG tool effect boundary (fs.write) and task acceptance (ACCEPTED/CLOSED_VERIFIED) for runtime.service
gate.selected_implementation: hg serve semantics (hg/tools/gateway.py LocalFileWriteAdapter + ActionGateway pending/reconcile; hg/verification/evidence.py AcceptanceGate + hg/http_api.py planned_write_readback_verifier) ported to the runtime.service contract as tools_automation/file_write_adapter.py, runtime/acceptance.py and BrainOrchestrator.pending_effects/reconcile
gate.rationale: Both runtimes need the same capability; the deployed hg serve semantics are reused rather than reinvented, extended where the branch contract is stronger (decision-digest binding, D4-approved evidence, symlink-free write paths). No capability is retired; hg serve keeps serving until ADR-012 consolidation, which needs its own gate.

superiority_basis.correctness: Same effect identity (SHA-256 of content), same atomic write and same per-criterion acceptance rules, including 'a failing result fails beside a pass'; 6/6 branch boundary mutations killed; full lifecycle reaches CLOSED_VERIFIED only through authority (EV-G-BRANCH-SUITE, EV-G-MUTATION).
superiority_basis.security: Branch adds: authorization bound to the exact request digest (path and content), symlink-free write paths, evidence counted only if D4-approved, memory: resources never dispatchable. Main kills its scope and pending mutations but not the read-back content mutation (EV-G-MUTATION).
superiority_basis.reliability: Parity: UNKNOWN on exception/timeout, unreconciled UNKNOWN blocks further effects and survives restart, reconcile inspects live state and never re-executes; branch additionally blocks acceptance while UNKNOWN is unreconciled (EV-G-PARITY-MATRIX).
superiority_basis.functional_coverage: fs.write and acceptance with read-back only; fs.read, code.*, test.run, url.read and the READ_ONLY process mode of hg serve are not ported (limitation, out of scope).
superiority_basis.compatibility: Additive: receipts gain task_ref/action/resource/scope/intent, POST /api/reconcile is new, composition now requires a readable receipt ledger; hg serve and its deployed state are untouched (EV-G-BRANCH-SUITE regression).
superiority_basis.performance_resource_cost: Not benchmarked as a service; local file write per effect, one worker thread per bounded adapter call; dispatch and acceptance read the receipt ledger linearly and D4-a reads the authority ledger per record, visible as 225.6 s for the Termux runtime suite (EV-G-TERMUX). Acceptable at current single-owner volume; indexed ledgers are the follow-up if volume grows.
superiority_basis.maintainability_operational_burden: Standard library only; one adapter module, one acceptance module, ~80 lines in BrainOrchestrator; no new service, database or governance module.
